name: BIRD-CRITIC
description: BIRD-CRITIC is a benchmark for evaluating large language models on the challenging task of debugging SQL issues, featuring 530 PostgreSQL tasks and 570 multi-dialect tasks derived from real user problems. It aims to rigorously assess models' SQL debugging capabilities in realistic environments.
reputation: BIRD-CRITIC is a recent SQL debugging benchmark built from real user problems and is emerging as a useful testbed for LLM-based database debugging.
notes: Includes two subsets: BIRD-CRITIC-PG (PostgreSQL) and BIRD-CRITIC-Multi (multi-dialect); accompanied by Six-Gym training environment and Bird-Fixer agent.
